# Fixtures for `saml` (SAML / XML Signature)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/legacy.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-idp-metadata.xml` | written by hand; the certificate is a fictitious self-signed one made with openssl (craft_legacy.py) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-response.xml` | written by hand; the certificate is a fictitious self-signed one made with openssl (craft_legacy.py) | CC0-1.0 |
